title: Siren Quickview: Compact Failure Investigator & Retry Lens
creator: Asha Kapoor
description: Design a compact, embeddable Quickview panel (codename: Siren) for the Redwood Console that surfaces failed requests, retry attempts, and payload diffs without needing to open a full trace. Target is to help engineers and on-call responders triage common failure patterns in under 45 seconds.
goals: Provide an immediately visible summary of failure class and confidence (error taxonomy + examples)
Show a condensed timeline of retries and outcomes (successful fallback, persistent failure)
Expose a lightweight payload inspector that highlights top-5 changed fields between attempts and shows KV-cache/reuse hints
Include one-click actions: re-run request (sandboxed), open full trace, link to backlog ticket creation with prefilled metadata
acceptance_criteria: Prototype implemented in Figma with responsive states for 320–1440px widths
Error taxonomy chips exist and can be filtered inside the panel (client, model, infra, quota, timeout)
Payload diff highlights added/removed/changed keys with tokenized previews for long fields
Retry matrix visualizes up to 6 attempts and annotates which attempt hit fallback policies
Panel loads summary metadata under 200ms in the Console mock (simulated data) and lazy-loads payloads on demand
Copy reviewed by PM and Docs; privacy checklist completed for PII handling and KMS pointers
design_notes: Compact layout: left column summary + mini-timeline, right column payload diff and quick actions
Use error-confidence badges (green/yellow/red) derived from model/server classification; allow hover for classification rationale
Payload inspector uses tokenization truncation with a ‘view full payload’ modal that redacts keys flagged as sensitive by customer settings
Optimize for fast perceived load: render summary + timeline first, defer payload diff fetch until user expands
Edge case: extremely large payloads (>500KB) show sampled key overview, with link to raw download guarded by RBAC
Accessibility: high-contrast badge variants, keyboard focus for retry buttons, aria labels for timeline events
tradeoffs_and_risks: Eager fetching of payloads improves UX but increases cost and exposes more sensitive data — settled on lazy-fetch by default
Compact UI risks hiding relevant context; mitigated by prominent ‘open full trace’ affordance and summary tooltips
Rendering many retries with large diffs can be heavy on client; fallback to rendered static summary for >6 attempts
One-click re-run in-place can be dangerous for idempotent semantics; button will be gated behind a sandbox flag and require explicit confirmation
